title.en: Your memory belongs only to you

sub.zh: 这些是你能自己验证的承诺，不是形容词。
sub.en: Promises you can verify yourself — not adjectives.

1b.zh: 记录与作品以 Markdown 存在你自己的文件夹；数据库与索引删掉也能重建。
1b.en: Entries and works are Markdown in your own directory; the database and indexes can be deleted and rebuilt.

2b.zh: 识别、整理、嵌入、问答都能在本机跑完，敏感内容不必出机器。
2b.en: Recognition, organizing, embedding and Q&A all run on your machine — sensitive content doesn't have to leave.

3t.zh: BYOK · 不为 AI 付订阅费

3b.zh: 要用云端模型就接你自己的 Key——模型要么在你本机跑，要么走你自己的 Key。
3b.en: Want a cloud model? Bring your own key — the model either runs on your machine or bills through your own key.

4b.zh: 导出仍是 Markdown，不锁格式、不设退出成本。
4b.en: Export is Markdown. No format lock-in, no exit cost.

note.zh: 会离开本机的路径，「隐私与数据声明」页逐条列了发出去的是什么、什么时候发生。
note.en: For every path that can leave your machine, the privacy page lists what goes out and when it happens.
